compound.name: umbelliferone (7-hydroxycoumarin)
compound.one_liner: 7-Hydroxycoumarin beside herniarin in chamomile; the pair carries the 'not the anticoagulant coumarins' point.

identity.note: Named alongside herniarin in curation.md; kept as its own small record so it can be linked. Drop if not wanted.

compound.teaching_note: Herniarin is umbelliferone with a methyl group on the 7-oxygen.
gaps: EMA range is herniarin + umbelliferone together.
